description: Use when the user asks for a list of known mineral sites, deposits or occurrences. Returns up to 200 sites, each with name, commodity, label, isPositive (whether the model uses it as a confirmed training example) and coordinates. Filter by metal and/or a bounding box; positive_only keeps confirmed occurrences only.
